description: Canonical single source of truth for SUCC claim-ID namespaces. Bare claim prefixes (e.g. PH-, PB-, TS-, WA-) were historically minted per-supplement and several bare prefixes are reused across DIFFERENT, disjoint-meaning claim families. Historical bare IDs are NEVER renamed: this registry is ADDITIVE and mints a stable, globally-unique fully-qualified ID (FQID) alias per namespace so downstream tooling (e.g. SUCC-to-YEAN proof extraction) has a collision-free key. Each FQID is a stable ASCII identifier; the bare ID remains valid within its own supplement file. Fully-qualified IDs require an exact registered bare prefix AND an existing table claim row; the registry is not permission to mint speculative claim numbers.

fqid_scheme.fq_prefix: An ASCII identifier of the form <BARE>.<TAG> (uppercase letters/digits plus one disambiguating dot-segment). <BARE> is the historical bare prefix; <TAG> disambiguates namespaces that share that bare prefix. When a bare prefix is unique to one namespace the fq_prefix MAY equal the bare prefix; when two or more distinct-meaning families share a bare prefix, each gets its own <TAG>.
fqid_scheme.NN: The historical bare ID's numeric part, zero-padded to width 2 (e.g. bare PH-01 -> ...-01, bare WA-15 -> ...-15). Alphabetic sub-suffixes (e.g. 06B) are not part of this scheme's numeric slot and are addressed per-supplement.
fqid_scheme.note: FQIDs are machine-parseable and stable: once minted here, a namespace's fq_prefix does not change, so a proof-extraction pipeline can key off it permanently.
